name: fdx
description: A Go package and command line programs for working with fdx XML files used by Screen Writing software.
releaseNotes: Scene numbers now survive a Fountain to FDX round trip. A Fountain heading ending #12A# becomes a Scene Heading with the FDX Number attribute set to 12A and the text without the marker; a Number on a Scene Heading is written back to Fountain as #12A#. Numbered headings therefore no longer carry the number in their text in FDX output. Requires fountain v1.0.3; the go directive is now 1.26.4.
